title: Peak-R-wave normalization of exercise ST depression does not establish added cross-hospital CAD prediction
abstract: Raw historical UCI exercise records include R-wave heights omitted from the common14-field representation. We tested a literature-motivated ST-depression/peak-R-height ratio against ridge logistic models with flexible additive standard predictors and both R heights. Hungarian development included293 patients;frozen Long Beach VA institutional validation included132,104 with angiographic disease. Brier loss changed0.254610→0.254783;gain-0.000173,1000 joint source-refit/target-bootstrap95%[-0.009414,+0.010469]. Source cross-validation also did not improve. Penalty sensitivity changes the gain sign. Missingness,sex imbalance,protocol mismatch and institutional shift constrain inference. No added benefit established;not proof of absent physiological information. AI-authored,self-checked,offline clean rerun supplied.
